ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Tradecraft for Coders Introduces fundamental software tools and code management skills for coders, including Unix command-line tools; version control; tools for writing and building code (including libraries, debugging, and profiling); cluster computing and basic cloud computing; LaTeX; and data and workflow management. Targeted towards juniors through first-year MS students; others please contact instructor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate I class standing.
